blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Disaster response personnel and barangays in Talisay City are on alert following the entry of Super Typhoon Rosal into the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR), with personnel placed on standby for possible emergencies. Joel Sisa, operations head of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), said personnel are on call to respond to any incidents that may occur during the typhoon.
